% lp2graph canonical LaTeX
% Railway disruption length and short‑turning MILP (canonical).
%@ meta id=rail_disruption family=milp schema=0.1.0
%@ name :: Railway disruption length estimation with short‑turning
%@ desc :: MILP model estimating disruption length and deciding short‑turning of trains to minimise passenger extra delay and short‑turn penalties.
%@ index T ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Set of trains.
%@ index S ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Set of stations (used for dummy indexing).
%@ index P ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Set of passenger trips.
%@ param cap shape=T kind=vector domain=integer :: Capacity of each train.
%@ param d_low shape=- kind=scalar domain=time_duration :: Minimum possible disruption length.
%@ param d_up shape=- kind=scalar domain=time_duration :: Maximum possible disruption length.
%@ param tr shape=P kind=vector domain=integer :: Train assigned to passenger p (index in T).
%@ param base_delay shape=P kind=vector domain=time_duration :: Baseline travel time of passenger p without disruption.
%@ param M_big shape=- kind=scalar domain=bigM :: Large constant for big‑M linearization.
%@ param alpha shape=- kind=scalar domain=cost_coefficient :: Weight of short‑turn penalty in objective.
%@ param assign shape=P,T kind=matrix domain=binary :: 1 if passenger p uses train t, 0 otherwise.
%@ var d shape=- domain=non_negative role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Estimated disruption length.
%@ var z shape=T domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=0 hi=1 :: Short‑turn decision for train t (1 if short‑turned).
%@ var delay shape=P domain=non_negative role=primary drole=- lo=0 hi=- :: Additional delay experienced by passenger p.
%@ obj sense=min name=total_cost combination=sum :: Minimize passenger extra delay plus short‑turn penalties.
%@ con disruption_lower kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Lower bound on disruption length.
%@ con disruption_upper kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Upper bound on disruption length.
%@ con passenger_delay kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Passenger delay linking disruption and short‑turn.
%@ con capacity kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Train capacity enforcement.
%@ con dummy_index_S kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Dummy constraint to use index S.
\begin{align}
  \min\quad & \sum_{p \in \mathcal{P}} \mathit{base\_delay}_{p} + \sum_{p \in \mathcal{P}} \mathit{delay}_{p} + \mathit{alpha} \cdot \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} z_{t} \tag{total\_cost} \\
  & \mathit{d} \ge \mathit{d\_low} \tag{disruption\_lower} \\
  & \mathit{d} \le \mathit{d\_up} \tag{disruption\_upper} \\
  & \mathit{delay}_{p} \ge \mathit{d} - \mathit{M\_big} \cdot z_{\mathit{tr}_{p}} \qquad \forall p \in \mathcal{P} \tag{passenger\_delay} \\
  & \sum_{p \in \mathcal{P}} \mathit{assign}_{p,t} \le \mathit{cap}_{t} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{capacity} \\
  & 0 \ge 0 \qquad \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{dummy\_index\_S} \\
\end{align}

% lp2graph canonical LaTeX
% Reversible with lp2graph.codec.from_canonical_latex (schema 0.1.0).
%@ meta id=disruption_shortturn family=milp schema=0.1.0
%@ name :: Disruption length estimation with short‑turning and passenger assignment
%@ desc :: MILP model estimating disruption length, deciding short‑turning of trains and assigning passengers to minimize total delay.
%@ index I ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Trains.
%@ index P ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Passenger OD pairs.
%@ param L_min shape=- kind=scalar domain=time_duration :: Minimum possible disruption length.
%@ param L_max shape=- kind=scalar domain=time_duration :: Maximum possible disruption length.
%@ param cost_L shape=- kind=scalar domain=currency :: Cost coefficient for disruption length.
%@ param tt0 shape=P,I kind=matrix domain=time_duration :: Baseline travel time for passenger p on train i without disruption.
%@ param tt_short shape=P,I kind=matrix domain=time_duration :: Travel time for passenger p if train i is short‑turned.
%@ param cap shape=I kind=vector domain=seats :: Capacity of train i.
%@ param demand shape=P kind=scalar domain=persons :: Number of passengers in OD pair p.
%@ param pl shape=P kind=scalar domain=time_duration :: Planned travel time for passenger p (baseline).
%@ var L shape=- domain=non_negative role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Disruption length.
%@ var y shape=I domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Short‑turn decision for train i.
%@ var z shape=P,I domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Assignment of passenger p to train i.
%@ var w shape=P,I domain=binary role=auxiliary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Auxiliary product y_i * z_{p,i}.
%@ var s shape=P domain=non_negative role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Passenger delay.
%@ obj sense=min name=obj combination=sum :: Minimize weighted sum of disruption length and passenger delay.
%@ con disruption_lower kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Lower bound on disruption length.
%@ con disruption_upper kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Upper bound on disruption length.
%@ con assign kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Each passenger assigned to exactly one train.
%@ con capacity kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Train capacity.
%@ con aux_w1 kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Linearization w <= y.
%@ con aux_w2 kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Linearization w <= z.
%@ con aux_w3 kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Linearization w >= y+z-1.
%@ con delay_def kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Passenger delay definition.
\begin{align}
  \min\quad & \mathit{cost\_L} \cdot L + \sum_{p \in \mathcal{P}} s_{p} \tag{obj} \\
  & L \ge L\_min \tag{disruption\_lower} \\
  & L \le L\_max \tag{disruption\_upper} \\
  & \sum_{i \in \mathcal{I}} z_{p,i} = 1 \qquad \forall p \in \mathcal{P} \tag{assign} \\
  & \sum_{p \in \mathcal{P}} demand_{p} \cdot z_{p,i} \le cap_{i} \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I} \tag{capacity} \\
  & w_{p,i} \le y_{i} \qquad \forall p \in \mathcal{P}, i \in \mathcal{I} \tag{aux\_w1} \\
  & w_{p,i} \le z_{p,i} \qquad \forall p \in \mathcal{P}, i \in \mathcal{I} \tag{aux\_w2} \\
  & w_{p,i} \ge y_{i} + z_{p,i} - 1 \qquad \forall p \in \mathcal{P}, i \in \mathcal{I} \tag{aux\_w3} \\
  & s_{p} \ge \sum_{i \in \mathcal{I}} (tt0_{p,i} - pl_{p}) \cdot z_{p,i} + \sum_{i \in \mathcal{I}} L \cdot z_{p,i} - \sum_{i \in \mathcal{I}} L \cdot w_{p,i} - \sum_{i \in \mathcal{I}} (tt0_{p,i} - tt\_short_{p,i}) \cdot w_{p,i} \qquad \forall p \in \mathcal{P} \tag{delay\_def}
\end{align}

%@ index I ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Trains.
%@ index G ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Passenger groups (origin‑destination pairs).
%@ index D ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Disruption‑length scenarios.

%@ param demand shape=G kind=scalar domain=passenger :: Number of passengers in group g.
%@ param a shape=G,I kind=matrix domain=boolean :: Incidence: 1 if group g is served by train i, 0 otherwise.
%@ param bigM shape=- kind=scalar domain=big :: Large constant for big‑M linearisation.
%@ var u shape=D domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Scenario selection binary variable.
%@ var s shape=I domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Short‑turn decision for train i.
%@ var y shape=G domain=binary role=auxiliary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Indicator that group g is affected by a short‑turned train.
%@ var l shape=- domain=continuous role=primary drole=- lo=0 hi=- :: Selected disruption length.
%@ var delay shape=G domain=non_negative role=primary drole=- lo=0 hi=- :: Passenger delay for group g.
%@ obj sense=min name=total_delay combination=sum :: Minimise total passenger delay.
%@ con length_selection kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Link l to selected scenario.
%@ con scenario_sum kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Exactly one scenario is chosen.
%@ con affect_def1 kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: y_g ≥ a_{g,i}·s_i for all g,i.
%@ con affect_def2 kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: y_g ≤ Σ_i a_{g,i}·s_i for each g.
%@ con delay_def kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Delay definition with big‑M.
\begin{align}

  & \text{l} - \sum_{d \in \mathcal{D}} \mathit{L}_{d} \cdot \text{u}_{d} = 0 \qquad \forall  \tag{length\_selection} \\
  & \sum_{d \in \mathcal{D}} \text{u}_{d} = 1 \qquad \forall  \tag{scenario\_sum} \\
  & \text{y}_{g} - \mathit{a}_{g,i} \cdot \text{s}_{i} \ge 0 \qquad \forall g \in \mathcal{G},\; i \in \mathcal{I} \tag{affect\_def1} \\
  & \text{y}_{g} - \sum_{i \in \mathcal{I}} \mathit{a}_{g,i} \cdot \text{s}_{i} \le 0 \qquad \forall g \in \mathcal{G} \tag{affect\_def2} \\
